I grepped Mathlib for `ProjectiveClass`, `KTheory`, and `RightExtension` (all hits for the latter are Kan extensions / bicategorical right extensions, unrelated), and there is no algebraic K-theory / K₀ development in Mathlib at all, so neither this functoriality-of-composition result nor any declaration from which it could be obtained exists there. The only Mathlib content touched is generic material (`addHom_ext`, `AddMonoidHom.comp_apply`) applied to library definitions, which does not carry the theorem's mathematical content.
